status: proposed institutional profile; not a registered METS profile
serialization: ZIP transport with complete SHA-256 manifest; sealed bytes are immutable
identity: Stable logical AIP UUID, monotonic immutable package version, version UUID and predecessor package SHA-256
logical_units: Top-level dossiers with all nested dossiers, maps, documents, ordered file references and ancestor context
rights: Unassessed by default; source-scoped documented grants and explicit review of source restrictions are required for readiness
representation_information: Per-object format registry assertions, significant properties and embedded documentation resources; unknown remains blocking
checksums: SHA-256 manifest covers every member except itself; METS fileSec covers every member except METS and the manifest; outer package digest is external
evidence: Original SIPs remain in the evidence vault; byte-exact source metadata and linked validation evidence are retained
acceptance: Structural validity, preservation readiness, institutional profile approval and archival acceptance are separate gates
